title: SMS Credit Calculation Guide (customer guide, A4, 5 pages)
notes:
The house style for Salesmessage customer-facing guides; every page is a self-contained one-pager. Imitate the structure, density and voice, never the facts.

Structure on every page: a 210pt light-blue radial hero band (white at left to #c2e3ff at right) holding the logo top-left and the date ('September 2026') top-right, then a pill-shaped topic label ('SMS credit calculation guide'), a one-line headline of 3-5 words whose last 1-3 words are blue ('How Salesmsg credits work'), and a one-sentence subtitle. Then 2-4 content blocks with even spacing, and a footer with the logo, 'salesmessage.com / (888) 409-2298', five social icons and the page number ('1/5') in blue. No divider rules and no sales CTA: these are help documents, not ads.

Content blocks used: a centered highlight panel ('1 SMS segment = 1 credit' in blue, a note beneath); an info callout (blue info icon, navy semibold title and navy text on a #f0f8ff panel), often closing a page; striped definition rows with rounded corners (semibold term, regular explanation); stat cards (2 or 3 across) with a big blue equation value plus a label and caption or two bullet points; a grid of worked-example cards (3 across, or 2 across for a pair) with a semibold title, a detail line and a big blue value; a three-column rate table with blue semibold column headers and semibold label/value columns; a two-column label/value table; FAQ (semibold question, one-sentence answer); and paragraphs whose sentences start with a bold lead-in ('Keep it short. ...').

Voice: plain, practical, second person ('your balance'). Short headings that state the takeaway ('Make every credit count', 'Check before you send'). Numbers are shown as values ('2 credits', '1 credit = 1 min'), not buried in prose. About 150-230 words per page.

Design tokens (A4 at 1190px wide, so 1px = 0.5pt): hero headline Product Sans Bold 32pt, letter-spacing -1%; section headings Inter Bold 18pt; labels, table headers and questions Inter Semi Bold 11-12pt; body Inter Regular 10pt; subtitle 13pt; pill 10pt semibold #0072db on Salesmsg Blue at 10%; date Inter Medium 10pt; footer 7pt gray #667085. Colors: ink #121517 for headings and body, accent #0180f4, callout navy #023359, panels and striped rows #f0f8ff. 35pt side margins, 10pt card radius, 7pt row radius, 10pt panel padding, 7.5pt card gaps.
